item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Israeli president picks Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu rival, to form government
item.description: Israel's president has chosen Gadi Eisenkot, Benjamin Netanyahu's strongest rival, to try to form a new ​government following a deadlocked election.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Trump offers press secretary role to UFC chief Dana White
item.description: The White House has been without a press secretary since October when Katie Zacharia left the position after less than a week on the job.

item.title: ABC News: For queer people, community sport can be life-saving
item.description: For many gay men, sport has been a place of isolation but queer sporting clubs are now giving them a sense of belonging.

item.title: ABC News: Prisons psychiatrist says NSW Corrections failing mentally ill inmates
item.description: After an ABC investigation revealed systemic failures in the care of prisoners with mental illness, a leading forensic psychiatrist says Corrections NSW should play no role in managing mental health.

item.title: ABC News: Race to tame inflation more tricky that one that stops the nation
item.description: All eyes were on the Melbourne Cup on Tuesday but they will quickly turn to bank balances as the latest interest rate rise sets in.

item.title: ABC News: There is no other store like David Jones and this might be the reason why
item.description: David Jones has survived two world wars, the invention of the car and the discounting boom. As luxury perfumes wafted through the stores that inspired its houndstooth trademark, did it lose the service that made it like no other store.

item.title: ABC News: A single fraud charge led us to a black market operating in plain sight
item.description: Black markets usually operate in the shadows, but a single fraud charge exposed one thriving in plain sight. Welcome to the world of demerit point trading.

item.title: ABC News: Deadly Krakow shooting prompts call not to 'exploit this tragedy'
item.description: Four women and two men are dead, 15 others are injured and the gunman is in hospital after a shooting in a market square in the Polish city of Krakow.

item.title: ABC News: When it comes to data centres, politics is getting very local
item.description: Governments all over the world are keen to cash in on the AI boom, but voters here are not yet convinced that whatever Australia gets out of hosting the infrastructure will be worth the cost.

item.title: ABC News: Has the curtain come down on the age of Trump?
item.description: Americans exposed the limits of Donald Trump's electoral power and weakened his grip on the Republican Party. But the Democratic landslide in the midterm elections does not spell the end of MAGA nor guarantee a lasting political realignment.

item.title: ABC News: ABC Wordage quiz: It's time to get to work
item.description: There's no time for a smoko or to have a bludge. Today's Wordage quiz will require some hard yakka.

item.title: ABC News: What Renée Geyer taught soul protégé Ella Thompson about authenticity
item.description: She's made fans out of Mark Ronson, Renée Geyer and Paul Kelly: Here's why Ella Thompson represents the heart of Melbourne's soul music scene.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: At least five killed in shooting at Krakow's main square
item.description: About a dozen other people have been injured after the shooting in Poland's second largest city.

item.title: ABC News: Who Gives A Crap confirms customer data exposed in third party software breach
item.description: Hackers accessed names, contact details and total spend, but not payment details or passwords, the company said.

item.title: ABC News: New Zealand may not know its government for weeks — key takeaways
item.description: The results in the New Zealand election are anything but clear with the two major parties — Labour and National — in the tightest of races.
